dedupe_keys.name: non destructive testing campaign on a steel bridge through acoustic emission sensors and accelerometers

description: An in-situ campaign examines a 65 metre steel bowstring bridge using acoustic-emission sensors and accelerometers. Six acoustic sensors monitor a longitudinal weld for two hours and fifteen minutes; acceleration recording lasts two hours. Acoustic acquisition is threshold-triggered. The measurements support local diagnosis and identification of bridge frequencies and mode shapes. The dataset is provided by University of Trento through BED. BED assigns the experiment to 2024. The provider metadata identifies compressed archives. BED displays download links with no stated charge. Actual file retrieval was not tested. The stated licence is CC BY 4.0. The measurements support calibration or checking of infrastructure response models. Sampling resolution is not established here unless stated above; file-level quality remains unverified.
